title: niphobolus rotundifolius
intro: Niphobolus rotundifolius, commonly known as Indian spikenard, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Aspidium genus in the Polypodiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties and is known to have multiple health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus rotundifolius include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
